# Third Space Learning

> > AI-powered maths tutoring platform built by teachers, serving 4,000+ UK schools with adaptive voice-based lessons for KS2-GCSE students.

Third Space Learning provides Skye, an AI maths tutor designed specifically for primary and secondary schools. The platform offers flexible tutoring delivery models including scheduled sessions, on-demand support, exam revision, and homework assistance, with proven impact data from 160,000+ students across 1,300+ academy schools.

## Core Products & Services

- [AI Maths Tutor Built By Teachers For Primary And Secondary Schools](https://thirdspacelearning.com/maths-tutoring/ai-maths-tutor): Skye AI tutor product page featuring voice-based adaptive learning for KS2-GCSE.
- [Maths Tutoring for Schools - Third Space Learning](https://thirdspacelearning.com/maths-tutoring): Main maths tutoring product page for 4,000+ UK primary and secondary schools.
- [How Online Maths Tutoring With An AI Tutor Works - Third Space Learning](https://thirdspacelearning.com/how-it-works): Explains how Skye's conversational AI provides personalised adaptive tutoring.

## Education Levels & Exam Preparation

- [Primary Maths Tutoring From The AI Tutor Built By Teachers - Third Space Learning](https://thirdspacelearning.com/maths-tutoring/primary): Primary maths tutoring solution for Years 3-6 with SATs revision support.
- [Year 6 Maths Tutoring Programmes - Third Space Learning](https://thirdspacelearning.com/maths-tutoring/primary/year-6-sats): Year 6 SATs preparation programme addressing misconceptions and practising exam questions.
- [Secondary Maths Tutoring From The AI Tutor Built By Teachers- Third Space Learning](https://thirdspacelearning.com/maths-tutoring/secondary): Secondary maths tutoring for Year 7 foundations and GCSE exam preparation.
- [GCSE Maths Tutoring From The AI Tutor Built By Teachers - Third Space Learning](https://thirdspacelearning.com/maths-tutoring/secondary/gcse): Unlimited GCSE maths tutoring for Years 10-11 with revision-focused personalised lessons.

## Tutoring Delivery Models

- [Scheduled Tutoring with AI maths tutor Skye - Third Space Learning](https://thirdspacelearning.com/tutoring/scheduled-tutoring): Regular one-to-one scheduled maths tutoring integrated into school timetables.
- [On Demand Maths Tutoring With Skye The AI Tutor - Third Space Learning](https://thirdspacelearning.com/tutoring/on-demand): Flexible on-demand AI tutoring sessions with real-time scaffolding and support.
- [Exam Revision with AI maths tutor Skye - Third Space Learning](https://thirdspacelearning.com/tutoring/exam-revision): SATs and GCSE exam revision support with unlimited AI tutoring at fixed yearly cost.
- [AI Tutoring As Homework - Real Time Maths Support For KS2 And GCSE - Third Space Learning](https://thirdspacelearning.com/tutoring/homework): AI maths tutoring assigned as homework with no added teacher workload.
- [After-school clubs with AI maths tutor Skye - Third Space Learning](https://thirdspacelearning.com/tutoring/after-school-club): After-school maths clubs using AI tutoring with flexible short-notice booking.
- [Cover Lessons From Scheduled Or On Demand AI Maths Tutoring - Third Space Learning](https://thirdspacelearning.com/tutoring/cover): Emergency cover replacement using AI tutoring to keep pupils on-track at fixed cost.
- [AI Tutoring Used As A Specialist Maths Teaching Assistant - Third Space Learning](https://thirdspacelearning.com/tutoring/teaching-assistant): Virtual one-to-one TA using Skye to expand teaching assistant capacity.
